message.content:
I don’t have a live API to pull the exact dates from, but here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian public‑holiday long weekends that occurred in 2023 (based on the federal holidays that most provinces observe).  If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta vs. Ontario), let me know and I can add those too.

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) |
|--------------|--------------|------------|
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan, Yukon) | **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Mon Feb 20) |
| **Good Friday** | **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (Fri Apr 7) |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) |
| **Civic Holiday** (most provinces) | **Aug 5–7** | Civic Holiday (Mon Aug 7) |
| **Labour Day** | **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 9) |
| **Christmas** | **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day (Mon Dec 25) |

### Notes

* **New Year’s Day** fell on Sunday, Jan 1, so it didn’t create a long weekend.  
* **Canada Day** was Saturday, Jul 1, so no long weekend.  
* **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11) was Wednesday, so no long weekend.  
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) was Tuesday, so no long weekend.

If you’re targeting a specific province or territory, let me know which one(s) and I can adjust the list accordingly.
